Her default theme starts off slower at 0.825x speed. Once
levels up, it speeds up by 0.25 until it reaches max level to the original beat per minute.
The secondary appearance of Giovanna bears a stark resemblance to Undead Sassy Witch.
Giovanna is canonically a transgender woman. The Undead Sassy Witch's
entry states that Giovanna resented being "assigned Mage at birth," a reference to how transgender women are typically assigned male at birth (AMAB).
